Stories discussed in this episode:

  • iPhone 18 Pro Max battery is so large that Apple had to add this new feature to iOS 27
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max teardown confirms US models still use Qualcomm modems
  • iOS 27.2 will help users transfer data and settings from old apps to their replacement versions
  • Apple Intelligence now requires nearly double the iPhone storage on the latest models
